## Scope and Evidence

State actual cost versus retail estimate, authorized resource boundary, source dates, currency,
metric, time periods and evidence links. Never mix currencies, ActualCost and AmortizedCost totals.
Link `contracts/03-cost-management.json` and its saved source/provenance.

## Cost Summary

For deployed Azure show last completed calendar month, preceding-month comparison and month-to-date,
using the selected run dates. Report actual source values and comparable-period deltas only.
For IaC show an explicitly labelled estimate, stated usage assumptions and unpriced components.
With unavailable evidence, state Not assessed; do not substitute a retail subtotal for actual spend.

## Trends and Forecast

Use actual observed periods for trends. Show a forecast only when supported by retained forecast evidence.
An unavailable forecast is not zero. Repeating a fixed estimate is not a forecast.
Omit unsupported charts instead of inventing data.

## Cost Drivers and Allocation

Rank only the evidenced scope. Explain shared resources, attribution, allocation basis, billing latency
and exclusions. An inaccessible or unpriced service is not free.
Do not double-count monitoring, overlapping scopes or commitment benefits.

## Optimization Opportunities

List traceable evidence, proposed action, dependencies, risk and method for each opportunity.
Quantified savings require a comparable baseline and explicit overlap controls; otherwise mark unquantified.
Right-sizing, reservation purchases, retention changes and deletion are nonbinding recommendations.

## Coverage and Limitations

Separate completed, partial, denied, unsupported and not-assessed data collection.
List unknown usage/licensing, missing periods/pages, unavailable metrics and external dependencies.
Keep actual operation failures visible; report generation does not make collection complete.

## References

Link the brief, WAF report, diagram, source queries or verified pricing evidence and applicable public docs.
Acceptance and review status live in recall and the project index outside reviewed report bytes.
